distances.label: Near
distances.instruction: Move close enough that the QR occupies about 60-75% of the preview. Keep all four corners visible.

distances.label: Medium
distances.instruction: Keep the QR at a normal scanning distance, occupying about 30-50% of the preview.

distances.label: Far
distances.instruction: Move back until the QR occupies about 15-25% of the preview, while it remains readable.

cases.label: Clean / angle
cases.instruction: Display only STR-CLN-ANGLE.png. Keep its recorded angle unchanged and vary only camera distance.

cases.label: Adversarial / normal
cases.instruction: Display only STR-ADV-NORMAL.png. Do not add glare, tilt or another degradation; vary only camera distance.
